profile.name: Yoctopuce 网络接口配置组件
profile.description: 这是一个非实体的软件功能组件，用于访问和配置带内置网络接口的 Yoctopuce 设备的 TCP/IP 参数。它可用于管理 IP、DNS、NTP、HTTP 回调、发现广播、网页服务端口以及网络连通性测试等网络相关设置。
profile.description_en: This is a non-physical software function component used to access and configure TCP/IP parameters of Yoctopuce devices with a built-in network interface. It is used to manage network-related settings such as IP, DNS, NTP, HTTP callbacks, discovery protocols, web service port, and connectivity testing.
